component.name: Cortex
component.summary: Find network shares and keep them as drives

description.p: Cortex finds the Windows (SMB) shares on your network's file servers and keeps the ones you use as network drives, on any Linux desktop.

ul.li: Suggests servers: the ones your drives are on, your network's (or VPN's) DNS domains and the file servers announced on the local network
Lists a server's shares, hidden ones included, or a domain's DFS folders
Signs in with one account kept in your keyring, or a Kerberos ticket, and tries a new password once before saving it, so a typo can't lock your account
Connects drives on demand or at login, and adds them to the file manager sidebar

description.p: First release: finding servers and shares, saved drives, sign-in, connecting at login.
